verdict.rationale: Mem0's own docs list setup guides for 22 tools, explicitly naming LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, and the Vercel AI SDK, so the core first-party integration story is documented. The evidence is a single homepage summary line, though, with no detail on how any integration works. Missing for 10: explicit LangGraph mention, integration-specific documentation depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
